import sys

def main():
    data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
    if not data:
        return

    n = data[0]
    arr = data[1:1 + n]

    last = [-1] * 100001
    left = 0
    ans = 0

    for i, x in enumerate(arr):
        if last[x] >= left:
            left = last[x] + 1
        last[x] = i
        ans = max(ans, i - left + 1)

    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
